svg.title: Where Nitro checks conditional transaction conditions
svg.desc: A vertical flow. Your app sends the transaction to a prechecker node, which checks the conditions against current state and again against state about two seconds old. The sequencer then checks them a third time against the block it is building, and the transaction lands in a child chain block. A failed check at either node returns JSON-RPC error -32003 and the transaction is not included.
